name: MERIDIAN: Place Account Hold
description: Signs on to MERIDIAN CORE as a supervisor and places an irreversible hold on a member's share, reporting the confirmation number.

inputParams.name: username
inputParams.description: Operator ID used to sign on. Must be a supervisor (e.g. "super1") for this action to succeed.

inputParams.name: password
inputParams.description: Operator password used to sign on.

inputParams.name: branch
inputParams.description: Branch to sign on at (e.g. MAIN-001).

inputParams.name: memberId
inputParams.description: The member whose share to place on hold.

inputParams.name: shareId
inputParams.description: Exact share id to place on hold, e.g. "101555-CERT" -- MERIDIAN identifies shares by id, not a fixed checking/savings pair.

inputParams.name: reasonCode
inputParams.description: Reason code for the hold: "FRAUD" (suspected fraud), "LEGAL" (legal / levy), or "DECEASED" (member deceased).
